task: Create one current OpenAI learning system that helps founders, creators, researchers, developers, and teams choose between ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.
audience: Founders and operators first; team leads, creators, developers, and researchers as routed role paths

references.label: Official ChatGPT surface chooser
references.reason: Defines the distinction between Chat, Work, and Codex.

references.label: Official ChatGPT Work guide
references.reason: Anchors the Work curriculum and capability boundaries.

references.label: Official OpenAI plugins catalog
references.reason: Replaces the deprecated openai/skills catalog in the technical resource shelf.

keep: Existing stable ChatGPT, Codex, and creator-guide URLs
One central academy with reusable role metadata
avoid: Separate subdomains or repositories for each product surface
Stale model, pricing, and repository claims
Decorative AI imagery or generic card-wall composition
direction.signature: Choose your role, choose the right OpenAI surface, and leave with one reviewable workflow.
system: Obsidian editorial canvas with restrained emerald, cyan, and warm signal colors
Role selector drives one recommended path without hiding the full system
Chat, Work, and Codex are compared by job-to-be-done, not product jargon
Verified resources carry dates, provenance, surface, audience, and lifecycle status
Static-first hierarchy, visible focus, reduced-motion-safe transitions, and no generated hero media

asset_quality.why_premium: The primary asset is the exact role-and-surface decision system itself; the curriculum UI is real product proof rather than decorative media.

artifacts.notes: Vercel preview is READY and CI-green; the browser URL policy blocked both the protected preview and the supervised localhost fallback.

checks.evidence: Tier C exact curriculum and decision UI is the primary proof; no filler or generated hero asset is used.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: The protected preview reached READY. After the machine gate permitted one bounded localhost fallback, the browser URL policy blocked it and explicitly prohibited alternate automation workarounds.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Desktop and mobile inspection remains blocked by the browser URL policy. The supervised localhost server was stopped and no browser-policy workaround was attempted.

checks.name: production-build
checks.evidence: Local and Vercel production builds completed, including 1,147 static pages and postbuild artifact tests.

checks.name: accessibility-mechanical
checks.evidence: Scoped ESLint and the Web Interface Guidelines mechanical CI gate pass.

score.notes: The architecture, content, code craft, provenance, responsive implementation, and automated gates are strong; five points remain withheld until actual desktop and mobile exports are inspected.
